name: Mixed sum-free, product-free, 3-AP-free classification in F_73^×
statement: Every subset of F_73^× that is sum-free, product-free, and contains no nontrivial three-term arithmetic progression has size at most 12; exactly three extremizers attain 12.
scope_note: Exact result for the stated three simultaneous constraints in F_73^× only; no asymptotic or all-prime theorem is implied.
